pages.text: “Aged aroma of time, mellow and lingering, infused with the essence of mountain and wilderness.”$(br2)Pu'er tea is a deeply fermented tea aged over long periods, giving it a rich taste and a distinct aged fragrance. The tea infusion is deep red and translucent, smooth upon entry, and known for its characteristic of becoming more flavorful as it ages. It is often called ‘a drinkable antique.’

Pu'er tea thrives in warm and humid tropical and subtropical mountain forests, particularly in high-altitude regions. The tea trees have an exceptionally long lifespan. Travelers can seek out wild tea trees and cultivate them using Pu'er tea seeds, allowing time to refine the tea’s flavor.

Pu'er tea plants grow similarly to most tea varieties.$(br)Each harvest provides fresh Pu'er tea leaves along with a small number of seeds. The unique processing method of Pu'er tea involves sun-drying the leaves, followed by extended storage and post-fermentation, allowing the tea’s flavor to deepen and develop over time.
